roundTwoFindings: All four fixed in ec52456102: the final check is testnats.AwaitStreamCopies(t, cluster.JetStream(t), bus.Stream, 3), which needs Replicas == 3 and three settled copies (internal/testnats/streams.go:40-43, 57-62); awaitReconciled's timeout reports HookStall(), the stall and the last failed run's error (internal/bus/nats.go:553-569); awaitHookFailure fails on HookedConnectionEvents() >= 1, which moves only on a successful run (internal/bus/recovery.go:216-217) of the publisher's one hook (nats.go:422-424); the four comments match the code.

reconcileFailure returns a hookFailure; the name is accurate for this publisher, whose only hook is the reconcile. Judged not a defect, no rename asked.
